title: Stellarion
tagline: Cross-chain swaps between Stellar & Ethereum with 1inch Fusion+ - fast, secure, gasless.
description: Built a trustless cross-chain atomic swap system enabling secure token exchanges between different blockchains without intermediaries. The protocol combines time-locked escrow contracts, cryptographic hash commitments, and Dutch auction pricing to guarantee atomic settlement - either both parties receive their tokens or the swap fails completely.
how_its_made:
Built a trustless cross-chain atomic swap system enabling secure token exchanges between different blockchains without intermediaries. The protocol combines time-locked escrow contracts, cryptographic hash commitments, and Dutch auction pricing to guarantee atomic settlement - either both parties receive their tokens or the swap fails completely.

For Stellar To Ethereum Cross-Chain gasless intent solving, we have created a Wrapped Token standard that enables permit2 in stellar tokens as well
